snippet.title: Chicken & Beer? Chimaek? No! Chicken 🍗 & Wine 🍷= Chiwa! (Mika in Korea 033)
snippet.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea 🇦🇹 🇰🇷 for more Videos https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/
And follow Daldal.tv for some couple content: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCt4Dm5x9HODOUr-nbnlT_Ng?sub_confirmation=1

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to the 33rd video of Mika in Korea. This time it was Children’s Day in Korea (어린이날) and we really had a great sunny weather on that day. So how about to meet up some friends and do a picknick in the Mangwon Hangang Park (망원 한강 공원)? Luckily my two close buddies Alex and Cedric (both Youtubers, please check out their channels) had some time on Children’s Day, so we met up in Hapjeong, bought some wine and ordered some chicken to enjoy it together in Mangwon Park (망원 공원). I know, usually it is chicken and beer, chimek, but since we all had chicken and beer a lot lately, we came up with the idea, to enjoy the chicken with some wine: Chiwa / 치와! We know it isn’t popular in Korea but in some funny way it worked. Of course it isn’t as good as chicken & beer (Chimaek / 치맥) but still we enjoy it together with wine. We really spent a nice time chatting about life, friendship and of course Youtube and stayed in the Mangwon Park until the evening. Thx Alex and Cedric for joining, let’s do this soon again!

As usually, if you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube channel yet, I would be super duper happy, if you would do so! Follow me on my adventures here as a foreigner living in South Korea. Again, thank you soooo much for watching, I truly appreciate. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 31st vlog. In this Youtube vlog I met up with a few Polish people to enjoy some traditional Polish Street Food in Jongno-gu, a place called „Long Sausage in the Hole“. There I met up with the Polish / Norwegian Youtuber Danibokki, Przemysław Krompiec (프셰므스와브 크롬피에츠) from the popular TV Show Non-Summit (비정상회담) on JTBC and with Tomek (the owner) and his lovely wife Misong. We ate Zapiekanka, a traditional Polish street food, something I didn’t eat for over 20 years. So this brought back some childhood memories for me. The Zapiekanka was extremely delicious, so if you want to try out some traditional Polish Street food here in Seoul / South Korea, you should definitely try out Long Sausage in the Hole. We really had a great time there, eating well and drinking some beer.

As usually, if you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube channel yet, I would be super duper happy, if you would do so! Follow me on my adventures here as a foreigner living in South Korea. Again, thank you soooo much for watching, I truly appreciate. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

ko.description:
더 많은 비디오를 원하시면 Mika in Korea를 구독 해 주세요 https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1

안녕하세요, 여러분. 미카인코리아의 30번째 브이로그에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 이번이 제 친구 수잔네와 함께 한 마지막 브이로그에요. 수잔네의 마지막 먹방 메뉴로 제가 선택한 것은 한국식 치킨과 맥주, 치맥인데요, 한국 사람들이 정말 좋아하는 메뉴죠? 저도 정말 좋아한답니다. 물론 치맥이라고 맥주만 마신 건 아니었어요. 수잔네에게 쏘맥 (쏘주+맥주)을 소개 해주고 싶어서 소주도 한 병 더 시켰답니다. 수잔네 한국에서의 마지막 만찬이었던 치맥, 아니 치쏘맥(?)과 함께한 그 날의 비디오 재밌게 봐 주세요. 맥주에 소주를 타서 그런지 정말 빨리 취하더라구요. 그 날 치킨집에서 진짜 많이 웃고 재밌는 시간을 보냈어요. 수잔네에게 한국어로 맥주 주문하는 법도 가르쳐줬는데, 이 부분이 제일 재밌었던 것 같아요. 저희가 치킨을 먹은 곳이 궁금하시면, 신도림에 있는 “여기가 만세닭”을 찾아보세요! 저희 단골집이에요.

아직 제 채널을 구독하지 않으셨다면, 꼭 구독 해 주세요!! 한국에서의 제 일상을 구경하시고 응원 해 주세요. 제 비디오를 봐 주셔서 정말 감사합니다. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

이번 비디오는 제 아내가 편집을 해 줬어요. 제 아내의 편집이 마음에 드신다면 댓글로 남겨주세요!! :)

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 29th vlog. And this time my Austrian friend Susanne and me went to the Lotte World Tower (롯데월드 타워), a supertall skyscraper located in Seoul and at the moment the 5th tallest building in the world. It is 555m high and contains 123 floors with the highest glass floor observatory in the world. So the scariest spot to be, if you are afraid of heights or you suffer from acrophobia. But I decided to face my fears on this day and went up on the highest floor of the Lotte World Tower. Did I get on the glass floor observatory? You have to watch my video, if you want to find out. Anyway, if you are in Seoul and you want to enjoy a great view over Seoul, the Lotte World Tower (롯데월드 타워) in Jamsil is definitely worth its money.

If you want to see the mentioned video of me at the Wiener Riesenrand at the Prater, please check this video:

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 29th vlog. And this time my Austrian friend Susanne and me went to the Lotte World Tower (롯데월드 타워), a supertall skyscraper located in Seoul and at the moment the 5th tallest building in the world. It is 555m high and contains 123 floors with the highest glass floor observatory in the world. So the scariest spot to be, if you are afraid of heights or you suffer from acrophobia. But I decided to face my fears on this day and went up on the highest floor of the Lotte World Tower. Did I get on the glass floor observatory? You have to watch my video, if you want to find out. Anyway, if you are in Seoul and you want to enjoy a great view over Seoul, the Lotte World Tower (롯데월드 타워) in Jamsil is definitely worth its money.

If you want to see the mentioned video of me at the Wiener Riesenrand at the Prater, please check this video:

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 28th vlog. And here we go with another vlog episode with my dear friend Susanne from Austria. For a little glimpse into the Korean food culture we went all together to explore the Gwangjang Market (광장시장), one of the oldest and largest traditional markets in South Korea. Quickly we got hungry and we went to the famous Bindaetteok (빈대떡) place called 순희네 빈대떡. Of course we didn’t just order Bindaetteok, we also ordered a few bottles of Makgeolli (막걸리) and got drunk pretty quickly. And this in the middle of the day. Haha! Susanne was also eating Kimchi (김치) fore the first time, which was a little bit too spicy for her. Susanne liked the Bindaetteok (빈대떡) a lot and we ordered quite a lot of them. If you go to the Gwangjang Market (광장시장) you definitely need to stop by this place!

ko.description:
더 많은 비디오를 원하시면 Mika in Korea를 구독 해 주세요 https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1

안녕하세요, 여러분. 제 28번째 브이로그에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 오스트리아에서 온 제 친한 친구 수잔네와의 두번째 브이로그에요. 한국 음식을 체험해보기 위해서 한국에서 가장 오래되고 큰 전통 시장 중 하나인 광장시장에 다녀왔어요. 배가 많이 고플 때라 광장시장의 맛집 „순희네 빈대떡“에 가서 빈대떡을 먹기로 했지요. 물론 빈대떡만 먹기는 아쉬우니 막걸리도 같이 주문했는데 정말 빨리 취하더라구요. 대낮이었는데 말이에요. 하하! 수잔네는 이 날 태어나서 처음으로 김치를 먹었는데 자기한테는 너무 매웠다고 하네요. 수잔네가 빈대떡을 너무 좋아해서 더 시켜서 먹었어요. 여러분도 광장시장에 가실 일이 있으시면 꼭 이 곳에서 빈대떡에 막걸리를 맛 보세요!!


아직 제 채널을 구독하지 않으셨다면, 꼭 구독 해 주세요!! 한국에서의 제 일상을 구경하시고 응원 해 주세요.
제 비디오를 봐 주셔서 정말 감사합니다. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

이번 비디오는 제 아내가 편집을 해 줬어요. 제 아내의 편집이 마음에 드신다면 댓글로 남겨주세요!! :)

snippet.description:

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 27th vlog. This time my dear friend Susanne stopped by in South Korea on her way home to Austria from her trip to Australia and of course I needed to show her some nice spots in Seoul. And if you think about some touristic hot spots and must-see locations in Seoul, Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌 한옥마을]) is definitely one of them. So we went out exploring Bukchon Hanok Village, making a small tour and admiring the Korean traditional architecture. After a long tour through the streets of hanok village in Bukchon, we decided to take a small rest in a traditional Bukchon Hanok Village tea house. There we met an international couple doing some sightseeing as well and after a nice chat in the tea house we decided to eat dinner together. It was really a nice trip and one of our highlights of Susanne’s trip to South Korea.

As usually, if you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube channel yet, I would be super duper happy, if you would do so! Follow me on my adventures here as a foreigner living in South Korea. Again, thank you soooo much for watching, I truly appreciate. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 26th vlog. And as you can see, I am back in Gangneung (강릉) to attend the Pyeongchang Cultural Olympic Event (평창 문화 올림픽). K-Beats and SBA inviting the Youtubers in Korea to come and of it was a great opportunity to hang out with my fellow Youtuber. Please check out their channels, the links are below. First we went to the Gyeongpo Beach 경포해변, which was really beautiful but unfortunately way too cold. But I will come back in summer for sure, the beach and the whole area are a great place for a vacation. Then we went to a famous Dakgalbi Restaurant (통나무집 닭갈비), where we ate a delicious lunch. After enjoying such a great meal we went to the main event today, the Pyeongchang Cultural Olympic Event, where we really had tooooons of fun and tried out many Korean snacks and dishes. It was a great day and we all had a lot of fun!

I hope you enjoyed my little vlog about my day at the Pyeongchang Cultural Olympic Event. Did you go to this event as well? How did you like it? And in generell, are you going to watch the Pyeongchang Live? Let me know in the comments!

snippet.title: KBS TV Show with Christian Burgos (Mika in Korea Vlog #025)
snippet.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea 🇦🇹 🇰🇷 for more Videos https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 25th vlog. After a small break from Youtube I am finally back with a new video. This time I was vlogging about my experience for the KBS TV Show „G-10 특집 다큐 오케이 평창, 웰컴 대한민국“ / „G-10 documentary. Okay Pyeongchang, Welcome Korea.“ where Christian Burgos (크리스티안 부르고스), most of you guys will now my Mexican friend from the TV Show Non-Summit (비정상회담), was introducing Gangneung (강릉) and Pyeongchang (평창) to me and my friend Timo / Hubertus. In the TV Show I was the guy from Austria and Timo / Hubertus the guys from Germany. We went to the Anmok Beach (안목해변), enjoyed the fresh air there, then we went to a fish festival, where we had some fun with the snow boat and also tried to catch a fish. And at the end we enjoyed our stay in a homestay, where a really nice family took care of us. We made some Mandu and spend a really nice evening together. It was really fun to meet Christian Burgos (크리스티안 부르고스), a really nice guy and we had a great time filming together for KBS. I really hope, we will have another chance one day, to shoot again together!

As usually, I really hope you enjoyed my vlog about the KBS TV Show. Please comment, if you have seen the documentary on TV and if you liked it. If you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube channel yet, I would be super duper happy, if you would do so! Follow me on my adventure here as a foreigner living in South Korea. Again, thank you soooo much for watching, I truly appreciate. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 25th vlog. After a small break from Youtube I am finally back with a new video. This time I was vlogging about my experience for the KBS TV Show „G-10 특집 다큐 오케이 평창, 웰컴 대한민국“ / „G-10 documentary. Okay Pyeongchang, Welcome Korea.“ where Christian Burgos (크리스티안 부르고스), most of you guys will now my Mexican friend from the TV Show Non-Summit (비정상회담), was introducing Gangneung (강릉) and Pyeongchang (평창) to me and my friend Timo / Hubertus. In the TV Show I was the guy from Austria and Timo / Hubertus the guys from Germany. We went to the Anmok Beach (안목해변), enjoyed the fresh air there, then we went to a fish festival, where we had some fun with the snow boat and also tried to catch a fish. And at the end we enjoyed our stay in a homestay, where a really nice family took care of us. We made some Mandu and spend a really nice evening together. It was really fun to meet Christian Burgos (크리스티안 부르고스), a really nice guy and we had a great time filming together for KBS. I really hope, we will have another chance one day, to shoot again together!

As usually, I really hope you enjoyed my vlog about the KBS TV Show. Please comment, if you have seen the documentary on TV and if you liked it. If you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube channel yet, I would be super duper happy, if you would do so! Follow me on my adventure here as a foreigner living in South Korea. 안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 24th vlog. This time i met up with my French friend Sebastian from the French K-Pop channel „Seboom“ and I challenged him to play a Korean Video Game Arcade Challenge. Austria versus France, Best of 7, the first one to win 4 games, wins the Video Game Arcade Challenge! Because Sebastian was my guest, he was the one to choose the first game and selected air hockey as our first battle game. We needed to play all 7 games until we could find out, who finally won this Korean Video Game Arcade Challenge. Next to air hockey we also played some Tekken, Basketball, Mario Kart, Dart and Boxing! It was really really fun and we had a great time in the iZone Pop Premium Game Lounge (아이존팝 프리미엄 게임라운지) in Sinchon. This time it is a longer vlog but I am sure it won’t get boring, I promise! ko.title: 한국 무제한 오락실에서 대결하다  🎮 🕹  오스트리아 대 프랑스 (미카인코리아 브이로그 #024)
ko.description:
더 많은 비디오를 원하시면 Mika in Korea를 구독 해 주세요. 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
그리고 인스타그램에서 Mika in Korea를 팔로우 해 주세요.
http://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

- 썸네일: 무제한 오락실 대결

안녕하세요, 여러분. 미카인코리아의 24번째 에피소드를 봐 주셔서 감사합니다. 이번에 저는 프랑스의 케이팝 채널인 „Seboom“ 의 호스트이자 제 프랑스 친구인 Sebastian을 만나서 한국의 무제한 오락실을 방문했어요. 여기서 오스트리아 대 프랑스 이름을 걸고 게임 대결을 했는데요 총 7번 경기 중 4번을 먼저 이기는 사람이 승자가 되는 룰이었답니다. 제 브이로그에 손님으로 와 준 것에 대한 감사의 표시로 Sebastian이 먼저 게임을 골랐구요, 그렇게 아이스하키, 농구게임, 철권, 마리오카트, 다트 그리고 복싱 게임을 했습니다. 신촌에 있는 아이존팝 프리미엄 게임라운지에서 대결을 했는데 정말 재밌는 시간이었어요. 이번에는 비디오를 좀 길게 만들었어요. 하지만 지루하지 않으실 거에요! :) 오스트리아와 프랑스의 대결에서 누가 승리했는지 비디오를 꼭 끝까지 봐 주세요.

제 비디오를 재미있게 보셨으면 좋아요 버튼을 눌러 주시고 댓글도 남겨 주세요. 더 많은 대결 비디오를 찍으려고 생각 중에 있는데 여러분의 의견이 많은 도움이 될 거에요. 제 채널을 아직 구독하지 않으셨다면 구독 버튼도 꼭 눌러 주세요! 한국에서 사는 외국인의 일상을 담은 제 블로그 많이 사랑해 주시구요 제 비디오를 봐 주셔서 다시 한 번 감사 드립니다. 여러분, 이번에는 꼭 끝까지 봐주세요. 끝이 재밌어요. :D 하하, 그럼 다음에 또 만나요, 안녕!

snippet.title: Korean Language Challenge 2017 / 2018 - Finally learning Korean  (Mika in Korea Vlog #023)
snippet.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea 🇦🇹 🇰🇷 for more Videos https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 23rd vlog and this timeI am announcing my Korean Learning Challenge. From 1. October 2017 until End of September 2018 I really want to study Korean, so I can finally be able to talk with my parents-in-law. Basically I started my studies a few years ago but i always interrupted them, and never continued until the end. But since i moved to Korea for good, it is really about time that i learn Korean properly. I am so lucky and i feel  blessed to have such great and caring parents in law, it’s a shame i can’t talk to them by myself. And this definitely needs to change, and this is the reason why i am setting up this Korean language challange! It will be also kinda tricky, because I also need to learn some Busan Dialect.

If you have any kind of advice, how to learn Korean faster and better, please let me know in the comments. I appreciate all kind of hints and advices. Learning the Korean language is inevitable, if I really want to live here forever. So I hope i will be successful with my Learning Challenge and master Korean within one year. Also please check out my other videos here om my channel, where I want to show you my life here in South Korea as a foreigner. Please support me with a „Thumbs up“ and if you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube Channel yet, please do so. I would really appreciate it. 더 많은 비디오를 원하시면 Mika in Korea를 구독 해 주세요. 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
그리고 인스타그램에서 Mika in Korea를 팔로우 해 주세요.
http://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

안녕하세요, 여러분. 미카인코리아의 23번째 비디오를 봐 주셔서 감사합니다. 이번 비디오에서 저는 한국어 마스터 프로젝트를 시작하려고 해요. 2017년 10월 1일부터 2018년 9월 30일까지 1년 동안, 한국어를 열심히 공부해서 장인어른 장모님과 대화할 수 있게 되는 것이 목표입니다. 사실 한국어 공부를 시작한 지는 좀 됐는데, 항상 뒷심이 부족해서 제대로 못했어요. 하지만 이제 한국에 살기로 했으니까 한국어를 제대로 할 줄 알아야 한다고 생각해요. 저희 장인어른 장모님 같이 다정하고 좋은 분들의 사위가 되어서 너무 기쁜데 제대로 이야기를 할 수가 없어서 답답하거든요. 이제는 제가 바뀌어야 할 시간이라고 생각하고, 그래서 한국어 공부 프로젝트를 이렇게 공식적으로 발표도 하게 되었습니다. 그런데 오스트리아 남자가 부산 사투리까지 배우려면 쉽지가 않을 것 같기는 해요.

한국어를 더 쉽고 빠르게 공부할 수 있는 법에 대해서 조언 해 주실 게 있다면 댓글을 남겨 주세요. 어떤 조언이라도 감사히 받겠습니다. 한국에 살려면 한국어를 배우는 것은 피할 수 없다고 생각합니다. 그래서 앞으로 1년 동안 한국어를 열심히 공부하고 마스터 해 보려고 합니다. 응원 해 주세요! 외국인으로서 한국에서의 생활을 담은 제 다른 비디오들도 많이 봐 주시고, 좋아요 눌러 주세요. 아직 제 채널을 구독하지 않으셨다면 구독 하시는 거 잊지 마시구요. “한국어 마스터 도전”에 대한 영상으로 다시 찾아 뵙겠습니다. 봐 주셔서 감사해요. 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

en.title: Korean Language Challenge 2017 / 2018 - Finally learning Korean  (Mika in Korea Vlog #023)
en.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea 🇦🇹 🇰🇷 for more Videos https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 23rd vlog and this timeI am announcing my Korean Learning Challenge. From 1. October 2017 until End of September 2018 I really want to study Korean, so I can finally be able to talk with my parents-in-law. Basically I started my studies a few years ago but i always interrupted them, and never continued until the end. But since i moved to Korea for good, it is really about time that i learn Korean properly. I am so lucky and i feel  blessed to have such great and caring parents in law, it’s a shame i can’t talk to them by myself. And this definitely needs to change, and this is the reason why i am setting up this Korean language challange! It will be also kinda tricky, because I also need to learn some Busan Dialect.

If you have any kind of advice, how to learn Korean faster and better, please let me know in the comments. I appreciate all kind of hints and advices. Learning the Korean language is inevitable, if I really want to live here forever. So I hope i will be successful with my Learning Challenge and master Korean within one year. Also please check out my other videos here om my channel, where I want to show you my life here in South Korea as a foreigner. Please support me with a „Thumbs up“ and if you didn’t subscribe to my Youtube Channel yet, please do so. I would really appreciate it. More videos about me learning Korean are coming soon, so don’t miss them. Thank you soooo much for watching! cheers! 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 22nd vlog and this time i met my Youtube friend to eat some All You Can Eat / Unlimited Korean BBQ in Mangwon. Together with Hugh from My Korean Husband, Yoojin from Dingtube, Nancy from Fancy Nancy TV, Alex from 미국친구 Michin Alex and Paul from 폴서울 PaulSeoul we ate tons of Samgyeopsal (삼겹살), Moksal (목살) and Usamkyeopsal (우삼겹을) and also drink some Soju together. You can find all these fellas Youtube Channels down below, please subscribe to them, they are really cool fellas :) All of us enjoyed the Korean Unlimited / All You Can Eat BBQ and I am sure we will come back here one day again.

I really hope you guys enjoyed my vlog with my Youtube friends eating this delicious All You Can Eat / Unlimited Korean BBQ in Mangwon. If you want to see more Youtube Videos / Vlogs about my life as a foreigner in South Korea, please don’t forget to subscribe to my Youtube Channel. 안녕하세요, 여러분. 제 22번째 브이로그를 봐 주셔서 감사합니다. 이번에는 유투버 친구들과 망원동에 있는 무제한 바베큐 집에 다녀왔어요. 마이코리안허즈번드의 휴, 딩튜브의 유진, 팬시 낸시의 낸시, 미국친구 알렉스, 그리고 폴서울의 폴과 함께 삼겹살, 목살, 우삼겹을 맛있게 먹고 소주도 같이 마셨어요. 제 친구들의 유투브 채널은 아래 링크에서 보실 수 있어요. 재미있는 친구들이니 구독 해 주세요. 우리 모두 이 곳의 무제한 바베큐를 맛있게 먹었기 때문에 아마도 다시 갈 것 같아요.

제 유투버 친구들과 무제한 바베큐를 즐긴 이번 브이로그도 재미있게 보셨기를 바랍니다. 외국인으로서 한국에서 사는 모습을 담은 제 비디오를 더 보고 싶으시면 꼭 제 채널을 구독 해 주세요. 또 한국에서의 생활을 담은 사진을 올리고 있는 제 인스타그램도 팔로우 해 주세요. 봐 주셔서 감사합니다. 다음에 또 만나요, 안녕!

snippet.title: Celebrating our 9th anniversary (Mika in Korea Vlog #021)
snippet.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea for more Videos https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCehQUCosGefZu2xG_cqqLDA?sub_confirmation=1
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 21st vlog about my life here in South Korea. In this vlog my lovely wife Sujin and I are celebrating our 9th anniversary. For that reason we went to Sokcho, where we booked a room with a stunning ocean view in the Lotte Resort Sokcho (롯데리조트속초). Before we went to the hotel we first went to the traditional market (속초 관광수산시장) to buy the famous sweet crispy chicken (닭강정). Then we want to go to the Sokcho beach but unfortunately the beach was closed on that day. So we went back to our hotel room, enjoyed the chicken with some beer, played some games in the game hall and talked about our future plans. We really had a great time in the Lotte Resort Hotel Sokcho, i can recommand that for your future anniversary dates. Thank you honey for organizing this trip!

I really hope you enjoyed my little travel vlog to Sokcho in Korea. If so, please give me a thumbs up and leave me a comments. Also, if you didn’t subscribe yet, please do so. I am vlogging about my life as a foreigner in Korea, so if you want to see more videos, please follow my adventure here on Youtube. Thank you so much for watching! 다음에 또 만나요. 안녕!

Before we went to the hotel we first went to the traditional market (속초 관광수산시장) to buy the famous sweet crispy chicken (닭강정). Then we want to go to the Sokcho beach but unfortunately the beach was closed on that day. So we went back to our hotel room, enjoyed the chicken with some beer, played some games in the game hall and talked about our future plans. snippet.title: Poopooland / 놀이똥산 - A weird Amusement Park in South Korea (Mika in Korea Vlog #019)
snippet.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea for more Videos http://www.kvlog.com 
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 19th vlog. This time me and my friends went to a weird Amusement Park called PooPooLand (놀이똥산), where everything is around poop / poo poo! :D It is indeed such a weird place to be, because literally everywhere you can see Poop and shit everywhere. Of course not real one, but still. You start at the beginning with some information about Poop and digestion and then you can see (and feel) how the food is processed. At the end you need to slide down a slide, to be excremented. One of my weirdest experiences in Korea so far, haha! Also PooPooLand is playing with the Korean words, because „놀이동산“ means amusement park and they slightly changed into „놀이똥산“, where they put the „poo“ into the word of the amusement park. Anyway, if you are looking for a special adventure and you are into wired amusement parks, i can recommend you to visit PooPooLand :) We had a lot of fun and shot a lot of funny footage. And as always, if you like this video, please hit the thumbs up and also subscribe to my Youtube Channel, if you are interested about my life as a foreigner in South Korea :) Thx for watching and have a great day, cheers Mika!

Also PooPooLand is playing with the Korean words, because „놀이동산“ means amusement park and they slightly changed into „놀이똥산“, where they put the „poo“ into the word of the amusement park. Anyway, if you are looking for a special adventure and you are into wired amusement parks, i can recommend you to visit PooPooLand :) We had a lot of fun and shot a lot of funny footage. And as always, if you like this video, please hit the thumbs up and also subscribe to my Youtube Channel, if you are interested about my life as a foreigner in South Korea :) Thx for watching and have a great day, cheers Mika!

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 18th vlog. Today my lovely wife Sujin and I went out to eat Jokbal for lunch. Sujin really likes Jokbal a lot and there is a good place in Sindorim, so we went there. Of course you can’t enjoy Jokbal without Soju, so we also ordered a bottle altough it was just early afternoon. Because we didnt eat properly for breakfast, we got drunk pretty fast with just one bottle. If you don’t know Jokbal, it is a Korean dish consisting of pig's trotters / feet cooked with soy sauce and spices. It is a very populuar dish in the Korean cuisine and something, Korean people especially like to eat with drinking at night. For all German and Austrian people it is comparable with „Schweinshaxe“ or „Stelze“.

snippet.title: Lotte World Adventure (롯데월드 어드벤처) and Roller Coaster (혜성특급) Madness (Mika in Korea Vlog #017)
snippet.description:
Subscribe Mika in Korea for more Videos http://www.kvlog.com 
and follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mikainkorea/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

안녕하세요 여러분 and welcome to my 17th vlog. Today Sunjin, Sujin and me went to the Lotte World Adventure (롯데월드 어드벤처) to have some fun and playing around a little bit. Lotte World Adventure is the largest indoor amusement park in the world, so if you are into Themeparks and you are in Seoul, South Korea, you definitely need to check out Lotte World (롯데월드). Altough we bough the Day-Pass, we couldn’t even do half of the attractions and roller coaster fun we planned to do. Most of the time there were huge waiting lines in front of every Roller Coaster, some even until one hour! Holy smokes! But we managed to get at least on one of the Roller Coaster in Lotte World and i was even allowed to film! Although they took away my camera at first, i got it back with the notice, that if the camera is damaged, it is my fault. And they were right, the Comet Express Roller Coaster (혜성특급) was sooo fast, that i really nearly lost my camera. Luckily nothing happened and i captured some funny moments during the ride. Unfortunately it was pretty dark during the ride, but you can hear us screaming well, haha! Lotte World is a fun Themepark to visit, so if you want to have some fun in Seoul, check it out. If you liked my video, please hit the Thumbs Up Button and also subscribe to my Youtube Channel, if you didn’t do so far. Did you also visit the Lotte World Adventure (롯데월드 어드벤처) Themepark? Did you also ride one of the crazy Roller Coaster, Comet Express? Let me know in the comments! cheers Mika
